text:
If your Monday plans are outdoors, keep the extra layer handy. Burlington starts gray and chilly, and the clouds likely hang on through much of the day, with a high near 60 and a north wind making it feel cooler. There may be a little brightness late, but this isn’t a warm-up day. The lake will be rougher than town, with north winds up around 15 to 20 knots early and waves 2 to 4 feet before easing. The water is 64, but I’d still be off the broad lake before the wind has its say.

Tonight turns quieter and colder, with a low around 43 and patchy frost possible in the usual cold spots. Tuesday is the payoff, sunny and closer to 64, with lighter north winds and waves a foot or less. Plan outdoor time for Tuesday, and for today, keep waterfront outings short and sheltered.
